text:
carl_support: FLAG: customer NimbusPay (ticket #7109) reports two streaming issues after the recent runtime flush tweak: truncated JSON in fncall payloads and occasional duplicate tool_event deliveries. Blocks merchant onboarding.

maya_sales: NimbusPay is on Dedicated ap-northeast. They need a quick toggle they can enable while we investigate.

sophie_product: Paste the raw stream capture and webhook errors so we can confirm framing vs payload corruption vs duplicate IDs.

carl_support: Snippet from their capture: ```
[frame 1] {"type":"delta","text":"..."}
[frame 2] {"type":"tool_event","name":"post_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_A1\",\"amount\":50}"}
[frame 3] {"type":"tool_event","name":"post_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_A1\",\"amount\":50}"}
[frame 4] {"type":"tool_event","name":"post_charge","payload":"{\"id\":\"evt_A1\",\"amount\":50"}
```
Webhook error: JSON.parse error for truncated frame; webhook also returns 409 for duplicate id.

henry_eng: Quick read: two related symptoms. 1) emitter can cut a payload mid-object when flushing; 2) same internal event id is re-emitted on retry/flush race. Both correlate with recent eager-flush change.

sophie_product: Short-term mitigations to propose:
- shim A: opt-in header to enforce atomic frames (server buffers until balanced JSON)
- shim B: runtime LRU dedupe on event ids behind a flag
- long-term: fix emitter flush ordering and add streaming regression harness

maya_sales: Customer asks for A+ B so they can enable both while we fix root cause.

ella_pm: Need decision and launch criteria by EOD. If we ship atomic-frames header as hotfix, define tests, staging validation, canary, and customer note. Also ask eng for effort estimates.

henry_eng: Estimates: shim A (atomic header) ~1.5 dev-days + 0.5 QA + 0.5 rollout. shim B (dedupe LRU) ~1 dev-day + 0.5 QA. Root fix 4-8 dev-days.

sophie_product: Proposed acceptance for atomic header hotfix:
- unit tests for interleaved delta/fncall sequences that previously produced partial JSONs
- e2e test with streaming SDK verifying atomic emission
- NimbusPay runs parser validation on staging endpoint (we provide header name + docs)
- Canary 10% for 6 hours, monitor parsing errors and duplicate events
- runtime toggle to disable if issues

infra-bot: maintenance-slot-check: ap-northeast tonight 02:00 JST -> available

carl_support: I'll coordinate NimbusPay for a staging test at 00:30 JST; they can validate quickly if we give them a header name and staging URL.

maya_sales: I'll prep the customer note explaining the temporary header and timeline.

sophie_product: Decision: ship shim A (opt-in atomic frames header) this week as hotfix and schedule shim B if duplicates persist. Root fix to follow in next sprint. @henry_eng assign?

henry_eng: Assigning to michael_eng. Filing GH: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/10123 title: "hotfix(streaming): opt-in atomic frames header for structured fncall/tool events". Michael starts tonight.

michael_eng: Taking it. Plan: header X-RW-Atomic-JSON: true -> server will buffer until a balanced JSON object boundary before emitting the frame. Add metrics stream.atomic.buffered_count + stream.atomic.errors. Unit + e2e tests and staging URL provided.

ella_pm: I'll own rollout checklist and customer comms. Once NimbusPay validates staging we do 10% canary for 6h and then promote if clean. Rollback via flag/toggle.

carl_support: Updating ticket #7109 with action plan and will post NimbusPay's staging result here.

maya_sales: Thanks team. Please surface any edge cases in the docs snippet (e.g., SDKs that rely on partial deltas).

infra-bot: deploy-plan-created: https://deploys.internal/plan/69142

michael_eng: Starting implementation. Will ping with PR + staging endpoint when ready.

carl_support: Standing by for staging link and will coordinate customer validation.
